posts.title: Hunting Memory Leaks in bsnmpd with DTrace
posts.description: One of my FreeBSD boxes runs `bsnmpd`, the base system SNMP daemon. The machine is on 15.0-p2, and the daemon kept growing until the kernel ran out of patience and OOM-killed it. That is not a good feature for a daemon. I could have just added a cron job to restart it and called it a day. posts.title: How to Fetch a Moving Target with Poudriere
posts.description: The FreeBSD ports framework has a simple idea about the world: a distfile never changes. It has a fixed size and a fixed checksum, written once into `distinfo` and verified every time after that. It is super useful to verify that the upstream has not changed the package, or that someone changed it without authorization.
